title: 36 Hours in Helsinki, Finland
abstract: Every corner of this cool Nordic city is heating up, with a renewed waterfront, renovated museums and revived industrial spaces.

title: 36 Hours in Seoul
abstract: Thanks to the Korean pop culture wave, the once underrated South Korean capital, with its new museums, plazas and restaurants, is reveling in a tourism boom.

title: 36 Hours in Charleston, S.C.
abstract: The city is in the midst of a restaurant boom, and King Street has become the embodiment of a new, saccharine-free Southern charm.

title: 36 Hours on the Left Bank, Paris
abstract: The Right Bank may be more international and trendy, but sometimes you want to pretend you’re inside a black-and-white Robert Doisneau photo.

title: 36 Hours in Cape Town
abstract: A plan for this stunning city might include a 5K run (or walk), browsing farm markets, dinner at a wine estate and, no surprise, heading up Table Mountain (by cable car).

title: 36 Hours on the Beach in Barcelona
abstract: Dine seaside, sip cocktails high above the water or just stretch out in the sand during this coastal weekend in Catalonia.

title: 36 Hours in Parma, Italy
abstract: This riverside city may be synonymous with fine food — Parma ham, Parmesan — but it also satisfies appetites for art, music and history.

title: 36 Hours in Portland, Me.
abstract: There’s more to this maritime city than great food: gracious parks, Victorian architecture and a thriving arts scene.
